title: Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (30 mins) | 🎙️ Reddit’s principal UX engineer shows how a custom Figma MCP and Cursor pipeline takes any designer from blank slate to shareable, production-shaped prototype in minutes—no Git required
summary: Blair Metcalf is the principal UX engineer at Reddit and the builder of Reddit Proto, the company’s in-house vibe-coding harness. With a design system MCP that maps Reddit’s product language to production code, Proto has reached 100% adoption across Reddit’s UX and product org, and more than 700 prototypes are live on it.
